surface_verification.justification: pure documentation-accounting change (a new read-only re-measurement script + its own tests, and hand edits to a planning ledger's prose); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the shared/scripts/tools/tests suite (951 passed, 19 skipped, 2 deselected) plus verify_local.py's mirrored CI gates.

behaviors.behavior: each of the 8 canonical status tags is counted once per backtick-quoted occurrence
a qualified status (`enforced, tested`) never double-counts as its bare prefix (`enforced`)
a row that splits its promise across two statuses contributes to both categories
the 5-category backlog line excludes bare `enforced` and `no-oracle`
main() reads a ledger file and reports counts as JSON
main() returns exit 2 with a stderr error on an unreadable ledger path
the human-readable (non-JSON) output path shows the backlog line
a legend-shaped block and a summary-shaped block each inflate every status they name by exactly +1 (the documented, accepted imprecision)
the real ledger's 'Re-measured' header paragraph stays in sync with the script's live measurement of the real file
the counting function is robust to a UTF-8 BOM, CRLF line endings, and non-ASCII text adjacent to a status token (the ledger's real on-disk shape)
behaviors.evidence: confidence-calibration probe (Step 3.8), not a committed test: uv run python one-liner against count_statuses()/main() with BOM+CRLF+non-ASCII fixtures, all clean -- see result.json reviews.confidence_calibration
